#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const int MOD = 998244353;

ll mod_pow(ll a, ll n, ll mod) {
    ll ret = 1;
    while (n) {
        if (n & 1) ret = ret * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        n >>= 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

vector<vector<int>> enumFIF(int n, int mod) {
    vector<int> f(n+1), invf(n+1);
    f[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) f[i] = (ll)f[i-1] * i % mod;
    ll a = f[n], b = mod, p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b) {
        ll c = a / b;
        ll d = a; a = b; b = d % b;
        d = p; p = q; q = d - c * q;
    }
    invf[n] = (int)(p < 0 ? p + mod : p);
    for (int i = n-1; i >= 0; --i) invf[i] = (ll)invf[i+1] * (i+1) % mod;
    return {f, invf};
}

ll C(int n, int r, int mod, const vector<vector<int>>& fif) {
    if (n < 0 || r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    return (ll)fif[0][n] * fif[1][r] % mod * fif[1][n-r] % mod;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, K, L;
    cin >> n >> K >> L;
    const int mod = MOD;
    auto fif = enumFIF(10000, mod);
    vector<ll> muls(n+1, 0);

    for (int i = K; i <= n; ++i) {
        ll m = C(n, i, mod, fif);
        for (int j = i; j <= n; ++j) {
            ll term = m * C(n-i, n-j, mod, fif) % mod;
            if ((j - i) & 1) term = -term;
            muls[j] = (muls[j] + term) % mod;
        }
    }

    ll ans = 0;
    for (int i = K; i <= n; ++i) {
        ll term = mod_pow(2, i, mod);
        term = term * fif[0][i] % mod;
        term = term * fif[0][i] % mod;
        term = term * fif[1][2*i+1] % mod;
        term = term * muls[i] % mod;
        ans = (ans + term) % mod;
    }
    if (ans < 0) ans += mod;
    ans = ans * L % mod;
    cout << ans << '\n';

    return 0;
}
